title: Federated Concept-Based Models: Interpretable models with distributed supervision
abstract: arXiv:2602.04093v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Concept-based Models (CMs) enhance interpretability in deep learning by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, concept annotations are costly and rarely available at scale within a single data source. Federated Learning (FL) could alleviate this limitation by enabling cross-institutional training over concept annotations distributed across multiple data owners. Yet, FL lacks interpretable modeling paradigms. Integrating CMs with FL is non-trivial: although FL supports heterogeneous and non-stationary client participation, it typically assumes a fixed shared architecture, whereas CMs may require architectural adaptation as the available concept set evolves. We propose Federated Concept-based Models (F-CMs), a new methodology for deploying CMs in evolving FL settings. translated_title: 联邦概念模型：基于分布式监督的可解释模型
translated_abstract: 概念模型通过将预测建立在人类可理解的概念之上，提升了深度学习的可解释性。然而，概念标注成本高昂，且很少能在单一数据源中大规模获取。联邦学习可以通过实现跨机构的训练来缓解这一限制，从而利用分布在不同数据所有者之间的概念标注。然而，联邦学习缺乏可解释的建模范式。将概念模型与联邦学习集成并非易事：尽管联邦学习支持异构且非平稳的客户端参与，但它通常假设共享架构固定不变，而概念模型可能随着可用概念集的演变而需要架构上的调整。我们提出了联邦概念模型，这是一种在不断演变的联邦学习环境中部署概念模型的新方法。F-CMs跨机构聚合概念级信息，并高效地调整模型架构以适应概念监督的变化……
tldr: 本文提出联邦概念模型，通过跨机构聚合概念级信息并随概念监督集合的演变高效调整模型架构，首次将可解释的概念模型与联邦学习相结合，实现了分布式监督下的可解释深度学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Federated Concept-based Models (F-CMs), a novel methodology that combines interpretable concept-based models with federated learning by aggregating concept-level information across institutions and efficiently adapting the model architecture to evolving concept supervision.
